instruction.text: Read the paragraph. Decide if the heading is suitable.

atoms.a:
Social Media

There are many platforms where people often share photos and videos. It can be a lot of fun, but it needs to be used safely.

Football

School starts at 9am and ends at 3pm. We also get one hour for lunch. It is important to be on time to lessons, otherwise you can miss out on valuable learning time.

Greece

This is a hot country in Europe where a lot of people like to go on holiday. Many people enjoy swimming in the sea here because it is a lot warmer than the British sea.

Exercise

Many people like eating these with chocolate, or even on their own as they are very good for you. They are one of your five-a-day. You can also blend these up with other fruit to make a smoothie.

Flowers

People like getting these as presents, and they grow outside. One common type is the sunflower, which can grow really tall.

Holiday

This is a way of communicating online. People can use this to call family members who live far away, or keep in touch with friends. It also lets you make shorter distance calls, such as to friends in your town.
